title: Canonical Profile (v1)
description: Validates internal/model.Profile exactly as read/written by internal/profile (Load/Validate/Resolve/BuildBundlePlan/BuildExportPlan) and exercised by testdata/profiles/example.json. Lives at library/profiles/<id>/profile.json in the canonical tree. This profile selects assets per game (games[].assets, keyed by role) — there is no single profile-level artwork override; that only exists in the generated legacy Decky ABI (decky-profile-v1.schema.json), which is rendered from this document by internal/profile.BuildExportPlan.

version.description: Must equal internal/model.SchemaVersion; internal/profile.Validate rejects any other value.

id.description: Canonical profile id. By convention equals the enclosing directory name, library/profiles/<id>/profile.json (not currently cross-checked by internal/profile, unlike the Decky v1 filename-stem rule).

description.description: Optional (model.Profile.Description json:"description,omitempty"); absent entirely when unset, not null.

theme.description: Optional canonical theme id (library/themes/<id>/theme.json). Not further validated by internal/profile today.

compatibility.description: Optional free-form compatibility metadata (model.Profile.Compatibility, map[string]string), e.g. adapter/tool version constraints. Not validated by internal/profile.

games.description: One entry per game this profile carries selections for. May be empty (internal/profile.Validate does not require at least one game), though a useful profile normally has at least one.

mods.description: Optional per-game mod selections (model.ProfileMod, json:"mods,omitempty"). Unlike the generated Decky v1 ABI, internal/profile.Validate does not currently check uniqueness-per-game here.

ProfileGame.description: model.ProfileGame. internal/profile.Validate requires a non-empty, profile-unique id and at least one asset; identities and retro are optional.

id.description: Must be unique among this profile's games[]. Free-form (e.g. "steam:123", "retro:n64:example-game") — not a SafeId, and not itself a cross-profile canonical identity.

identities.description: Optional map of adapter name to that adapter's native id for this game (e.g. {"steam": "123", "playnite": "<uuid>", "romm": "42"}). Keys and values are unrestricted strings; internal/profile does not validate this map's shape, though internal/profile.adapterDestination currently reads the "steam", "playnite", and "romm" keys.

assets.description: Per-role asset selections. Must have at least one entry (internal/profile.Validate rejects a game with zero assets). Keys are restricted to the AssetRole vocabulary.

RetroTarget.description: model.RetroTarget. Both fields are required whenever "retro" is present at all — the Go struct has no omitempty on either field once the pointer is non-nil.

system.description: Retro system identifier, validated with the same rule as any other SafeId (internal/config.IsSafeID).

stem.description: Filename stem or relative identifier within the system (e.g. "Example Game"), validated by internal/profile.safeRelativePath. Not necessarily a SafeId — spaces and mixed case are permitted.

AssetSelection.description: model.AssetSelection. sha256 and extension are required; variant is optional free-form metadata.

sha256.description: Exact-byte SHA-256 of the selected asset's content, resolved by internal/profile.Resolve against library/assets/sha256/<sha256[:2]>/<sha256>/content.<extension>.

variant.description: Optional free-form variant metadata (model.AssetSelection.Variant, map[string]string). Not validated by internal/profile.
